topic: How Face ID Recognises You in the Dark

lines.say: Your iPhone recognises you in total darkness. So what is it looking at? And could a fake face fool it?
lines.show: Your iPhone recognises you in *total darkness.* So what is it looking at? And could [a fake face fool it?]

lines.say: Next to the selfie camera sit three tiny parts: a light, a dot projector and a special camera.
lines.show: Next to the selfie camera sit *three tiny parts:* a light, a dot projector and a [special camera.]

lines.say: First, the light washes your face in infrared light. Your eyes can't see it, but that camera can.
lines.show: First, the light washes your face in *infrared light.* Your eyes can't see it, but [that camera can.]

lines.say: Then the projector fires more than thirty thousand invisible dots at your face.
lines.show: Then the projector fires more than [30,000 invisible dots] at your face.

lines.say: The camera sits beside the projector, so it sees the dots from a different angle. That angle tells your phone how far away your nose and cheeks are.
lines.show: The camera sits *beside* the projector, so it sees the dots from a different angle. That angle tells your phone [how far away] your nose and cheeks are.

lines.say: It turns that into a 3D map, adds the infrared picture, and checks them against your saved face data.
lines.show: It turns that into a *3D map,* adds the infrared picture, and checks them against [your saved face data.]

lines.say: That's why a photo of you won't unlock it. A photo is flat.
lines.show: That's why a *photo* of you won't unlock it. [A photo is flat.]

lines.say: But a week after the iPhone X went on sale in twenty-seventeen, a Vietnamese security firm claimed a hundred-and-fifty-dollar 3D mask fooled it. Experts said key test details were missing.
lines.show: But a week after the iPhone X went on sale in 2017, a Vietnamese security firm claimed a *$150 3D mask* fooled it. Experts said [key test details were missing.]

lines.say: So the dark was never the problem. Your phone brings its own invisible light. The hard part is telling your face from a copy.
lines.show: So the dark was *never the problem.* Your phone brings its own invisible light. The hard part is telling [your face from a copy.]

lines.say: Follow for how everyday tech really works.
lines.show: Follow for how [everyday tech] really works.
